# HardwareAware_DesignSpace

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A structured representation of tunable parameters spanning circuit-level (e.g., bias currents, capacitor sizes) and network-level (e.g., neuron thresholds, synaptic weights) choices in mixed-signal SNNs. Provides a formal method to explore trade-offs between accuracy, power, and area in iNEST implementations, reducing manual trial-and-error.
